authorization: User requested local deploy/rollback, authorized self-managed test credentials and environment, sequential versions, and experimental submodule cleanup after retained results.

configuration_references.database: Dedicated lean-benchmark-db-20261023 container, casetodian_benchmark database; no source database connection.

timing_scope: Per-attempt elapsed time covers service replacement and verification after the pre-mutation attempt record; artifact builds and plan preparation are excluded.
interpretation: A common mechanical deployment plan is exercised for both labels. Lean 4.7.0 has no lean-playbook. This does not evaluate autonomous agent deployment behavior or compare two deployment implementations.
resume: Retain already built pinned images, migrated isolated database and sentinel; retry only deployment after correcting the internal-only port-publishing preflight. Failed pilot retained separately.

configuration_preflight: Required synthetic KEYCLOAK_API_AUDIENCE added after the 503 configuration failure; authorization assertions and application code unchanged.
